summary.narrative: Seven rows tiling MT 41:12-43:27 reviewed on the literary-form lens, no sampling. Two supported (42:1-42:14; 43:1-43:9) and five challenged. One challenge moves a boundary: MT 41:12-41:26 holds a measured accounting at 41:12-41:15 and an unmeasured description of finish and furnishings at 41:16-41:26, with no measure verb in chapter 41 after 41:15 and no dimension at all in 41:16-41:21, so a cut at Ezek.41.16 is proposed and the measurement unit type answers to the first movement only. The other four leave their boundaries standing and correct claims the rows carry: the ketiv/qere at MT 42:16 falls on the numeral word, not beside it, so the east side reads five hundred with the qere and five with the ketiv, against the three parallel sides at 42:17-42:19; the doubled torah-of-the-house formula is contained inside MT 43:12 and does not frame 43:10-43:12; the one ketiv/qere reading pair in MT 43:13-43:17 is at 43:16, MT 43:15 carrying editorial notes instead; and MT 43:18 opens with the guide speech verb ahead of the address and the messenger formula, a device the same cluster treats as boundary-grade at 42:13. Every unit type in the cluster sits inside the closed twelve-value vocabulary, and the tiling is contiguous over 62 verses with no gap and no overlap.

unresolved_uncertainty.what: Whether the seam inside MT 41:12-41:26 belongs at 41:16 or at 41:15 turns on how the closing clause of 41:15 is weighed, since it names the structures the following description then takes up.
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: This lane places 41:15 with the measured accounting because the measure verb and the hundred-cubit figure are both in that verse, but a reading that treats the naming clause as the head of the description would put the seam one verse earlier. The two-movement finding is the same either way; only the exact verse moves.

unresolved_uncertainty.what: Whether any ketiv/qere outside the chapter-40 cluster other than MT 42:16 falls on a numeral was not swept across the book by this lane.
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: The finding at 42:16 is therefore stated for that verse and its three parallel sides only, and is not offered as a book-wide count or as an exclusivity claim.
